text:
sara-partnerships: Heads up  CloudScale wants to go live in apac-sg-2 this week via marketplace. They need A100 quota, vGPU burst, and KMS entitlement for CMKs. Can infra + legal clear by EOD Thu?

devin-cloudops: need exact SKUs + partner provider id to open quota with provider.

mike-cloudscale: provider id cloudscale-p-993. SKUs: 4x A100-80GB (dedicated), 8 vGPU-burst. traffic estimate ~120k vGPU hours/mo. CMK: partner supplies key, we need entitlement + IAM mapping.

sara-partnerships: rachel can you check Dedicated pool headroom?

rachel-ops: current spare A100s in region = 2. we can either reserve 4 (30d temp reserve) or allow burst into shared pool. reserve needs legal OK for CMK audit flow.

anika-legal: CMK allowed under MSA but need partner non-export consent + we must receive audit logs to our compliance bucket. I'll send templates to sara.

ben-infra: ready to submit provider payload when devin confirms mapping. payload: partner_account=cloudscale-p-993, region=apac-sg-2, resources=[A100-80GB-dedicated x4, vGPU-burst x8], justification=marketplace onboarding.

devin-cloudops: mapping confirmed (PRJ-REDWOOD-APAC2 -> cloudscale-p-993). ben file the ticket.

quota-bot: Ticket Q-48299 created with provider (ref PRV-993-2261). provider ETA 48h.

sara-partnerships: action items: ben submit (done), anika send templates (ASSIGNED), sara approve reserve after legal OK (PENDING), rachel prep canary runbook. I'll tell partner they can push listing 48h if needed.

mike-cloudscale: partner can hold listing 48h. aiming for Monday public listing. will send final SKU confirmation.
anika-legal: templates sent to sara. need signed consent before we enable CMK entitlement.

rachel-ops: canary checklist: reserve 30d, 5% traffic 24h, monitor latency & errors, auto-fallback to euw1 if latency > 400ms for 3min, post-canary review.

sara-partnerships: thanks everyone. I'll update partner after provider decision or if provider needs more info. :rocket:
